translationRepairs: Prince Yong Cunmei, a son of the Martial Emperor and Zhuangzong's third younger brother, received his title in Tongguang 3.
Prince of Yong Cunmei, a son of the Martial Emperor and Zhuangzong's third younger brother, received his title in Tongguang 3.

Focus unit titles him 邕王存美; 'Prince Yong' under-renders the noble title. 'Prince of Yong' is the correct English form, but the proposed parenthetical Chinese character cannot appear in the English field.
Congrong then nominated Vice Minister of Justice Liu Zan as his tutor and Hanlin Academician Cui Ruan as chief administrator of the marshal's headquarters.
Congrong then nominated Vice Minister of Justice Liu Zan as his tutor and Hanlin Academician Cui Zhuo as chief administrator of the marshal's headquarters.
Focus unit names 崔棁; 棁 is Zhuo, not Ruan. Cui Zhuo corrects a real personal-name error and leaves the rest of the idiomatic intact.
Congrong then memorialized for Vice Minister of Justice Liu Zan as prince tutor and for Hanlin Academician Cui Ruan as chief administrator of the marshal's headquarters.
Congrong then memorialized for Vice Minister of Justice Liu Zan as prince tutor and for Hanlin Academician Cui Zhuo as chief administrator of the marshal's headquarters.
The same 崔棁 governs the literal field; Ruan is an unsupported reading of 棁, and Cui Zhuo restores the correct name.
